scope: Post-popup (post-OPTIONS) evidence set for the launch-10 Townfall Item Spawner acceptance ladder: every runtime print/log line the unchanged mod can emit, the pad input flow, per-rung log evidence, and the mod-own failure taxonomy. Read-and-derive only; no canonical edits.

main_lua.note: Canonical staged copy. All 22 other 21,415 B TownfallItemSpawner main.lua copies under outputs/** are byte-identical (same MD5); the single 21,414 B outlier (worker-itemspawner-bundle/host-test/root-badsize) is a deliberately corrupted loadlist fixture, not a candidate. All line pins below hold for every staged tree.

uehelpers_lua.note: All 9,962 B copies byte-identical. UEHelpers emits ZERO runtime prints (grep: no print/log calls). drain_stall_evidence: UE4SS.log init carries the two R3 lines: '[R3] refused: EngineTick pre-callback registrations (GameThreadInitializer + QueryHarnessDispatch) (detour registration compiled out under R3 marshal mode)' + '[R3] EngineTick detour unavailable; deferring game-thread pump to R3 marshal' (API-GAP.md section 5 table; initializer-l10-r3:1859-1860) — with these, menu can never open; total unresponsiveness to OPTIONS is EXPECTED, not new info
first-OPTIONS silence: press OPTIONS once after map load; zero new '[TownfallItemSpawner]' lines = keybind unreachable OR drain stalled (see POST-POPUP.md discrimination table)

call-time throw variant: 'ExecuteInGameThread: EngineTick method requested but EngineTick hook is not available (AOB scan failed)' (LuaMod.cpp:4729, verified in composed source) — in THIS mod the first ExecuteInGameThread call happens at the FIRST PAD PRESS (main.lua:695), not at load, so this error appears at first press; NOTE API-GAP.md section 5 says 'immediate at registration' which is true for mods that call it at load — for this mod the timing is first-press
drain_crosscheck_vs_api_gap.menu_opens_but_spawn_never_executes: structurally impossible from the queue alone: all six callbacks share one m_engine_tick_actions queue (LuaMod.cpp:4774-4790), so any drain that opens the menu also drains spawn. Observable decompositions: (a) CROSS on an empty '---' slot is silent by design (spawnSelected nil-entry return main.lua:220); (b) busy gate shows 'Wait for the previous spawn.' in the STATUS row, no log (main.lua:217); (c) spawn ran and failed -> 'Failed at ...' line exists (:342); (d) true mid-session pump death freezes the WHOLE menu (nav, page, close all drained) — distinguishable from (a)/(b) by whether the red marker still moves.
